description: Scan and optionally prepare a guarded token buy through the same armed local-signer path on every supported EVM chain. Robinhood Chain 4663 is the default. Resolves identity and pools, checks structural risk, proves the sell route, quotes, then hands execution to the loopback signer under owner policy.

recipient.description: User wallet that receives tokens. Required for prepare.

tokenIn.description: Base/quote token address required for quote and prepare.

name: evm_token_sniper_scan
